topic: Asking the Tutor for Extra Help

script.title: EXTRA HELP WITH FRACTIONS
script.story_hook: Emma stays late to fix her fraction trouble.
script.intro_zh: 艾瑪留到很晚，向數學老師請教分數的問題。
script.welcome_en: Welcome back to our listening series! Today we visit the library after class.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎回到我們的聽力練習！今天我們來到放學後的圖書館。
script.outro: That's all for today's session. Keep practicing those fractions, and see you next time!
script.outro_zh: 今天的練習就到這裡。繼續練習分數，我們下次見！
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat the most useful sentences together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起跟讀最實用的句子。
script.char_a_description: a teenage girl around fifteen, long straight black hair in a high ponytail, round wire glasses, a bright yellow hoodie, blue jeans, white sneakers, slim build, clutching a notebook nervously.
script.char_b_description: a middle-aged woman in her early forties, shoulder-length curly brown hair, a sage green cardigan over a white blouse, beige trousers, a simple wrist watch, medium build, warm patient smile.
script.youtube_title: 【建議收藏】📚課後找老師補數學，60句美式聽力｜分數不會算？聽完就會說｜老師一句話點破🌱Extra Help with Fractions💪
script.youtube_title_en: "You Already Know It" - Asking the Tutor for Extra Help after School
script.youtube_description:
不會開口請人幫忙？這段課後補習對話一次聽到位！
放學後的圖書館裡，艾瑪向數學老師請教分數：說明困難、相約週四再補、加入練習小組，60 句連貫美式聽力，語速自然、情境真實。
你會聽到：
🎧 請求幫忙："I really need help with fractions."
🎧 確認時段："What time should I show up?"
🎧 道歉與原諒："Did you leave it at home?"
🎧 道別："Thanks to you, fractions aren't scary."
後半段為逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：先聽懂、再跟著說，越練越順。
🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用。
每天一小段真實對話，讓英文住進你的耳朵裡。
喜歡請按訂閱並開啟小鈴鐺，我們下一集見！
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
script.youtube_description_en: Struggling to ask for help in English? This after-school tutoring dialogue covers everything you need. Emma visits her math tutor about fractions, then books an extra session and joins a study group. You will hear 60 lines of natural American English: polite requests, scheduling, apologies, and thanks. The second half is a sentence-by-sentence listen and repeat workout. Perfect for A2 learners who want everyday school English that sticks. No memorizing needed, just listen often. Subscribe for a new dialogue every week. #EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🎧課後輔導英文｜約時間・問考點・加入練習小組｜聽完就能說｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背多聽就會用｜🎧60句聽力跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
跟老師說「我不會」，用英文該怎麼開口？臨時換時間、借同桌筆記，又該怎麼說？
這一集帶大家走進放學後的圖書館，看艾瑪向數學老師請教分數，從說明困難、相約週四補課，到加入練習小組。
你會聽到：
🎧 請求幫忙："I really need help with fractions." 說出你的困難最自然的方式。
🎧 確認時段："What time should I show up?" 相約見面必學的片語。
🎧 安排補課："Can I come in on Thursday too?" 多問一句，就多一個選擇。
🎧 表達感謝："Thanks to you, fractions aren't scary." 讓道謝更有溫度的說法。
後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習 🎧 先聽一遍、再跟著說一遍，60 個句子從耳朵一路練到嘴巴。
🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背，多聽就會用。把句型聽熟，開口時自然就會了。
願你下一次需要幫忙時，能自信地說出那一句英文。
script.thumbnail_action: holding up a fraction worksheet next to her tutor

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, are you the math tutor?
dialogue.zh: 嗨，請問你是數學老師嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I'm Ms. Park. You're Emma, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪm ˈmɪz ˈpɑɹk jɚ ˈɛmə ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 是的，我是帕克老師。你是艾瑪，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes! I really need help with fractions.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs aɪ ˈɹɪli nid hɛlp wɪð ˈfræʃənz/
dialogue.zh: 對！我在分數這部分真的需要幫忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, grab a seat. What feels tricky?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ ɡɹæb ə sit wʌt filz ˈtɹɪki/
dialogue.zh: 沒問題，先坐下。你覺得哪裡不順？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, adding them confuses me a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm ˈædɪŋ ðɛm kənˈfjuz mi ə lɑt/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，把它們加起來常常讓我搞不懂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, let's start with pizza slices.
dialogue.zh: 好，我們從披薩切片開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Pizza? That sounds kind of fun.
dialogue.zh: 披薩？聽起來蠻有趣的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Half a pizza plus one quarter, how many slices?
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf ə ˈpitsə plʌs wʌn ˈkwɔɹtɚ haʊ ˈmɛni ˈslaɪsəz/
dialogue.zh: 半個披薩再加四分之一，一共幾片？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, three quarters? Like three slices?
dialogue.zh: 嗯，四分之三？就是三片嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly! You already know it.
dialogue.zh: 完全正確！你早就會了嘛。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? This actually feels easier now.
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？現在感覺容易多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's try thirds next, okay?
dialogue.zh: 我們接著試三等分，好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sure, but my homework is due Friday.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊɹ bʌt maɪ ˈhomˌwɜk ɪz dju ˈfɹaɪdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 好，可是我的作業星期五要交。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We still have plenty of time.
dialogue.zh: 我們的時間還很充裕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I come in on Thursday too?
dialogue.zh: 我星期四也可以來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thursday? Let me check my calendar.
dialogue.zh: 星期四？我查一下行事曆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I have soccer practice on Wednesdays.
dialogue.zh: 我每週三都有足球練習。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So Thursday after school works for you?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈθɜɹzdeɪ ˈæftɚ skul wɜks fɚ ju/
dialogue.zh: 所以星期四放學後你沒問題？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes! What time should I show up?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs wʌt taɪm ʃʊd aɪ ʃoʊ ʌp/
dialogue.zh: 對！我要幾點到？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three thirty, same table as today.
dialogue.zh: 三點半，跟今天同一張桌子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great! Oh no, where's my worksheet?
dialogue.zh: 太好了！糟糕，我的學習單呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Did you leave it at home?
dialogue.zh: 你把它放在家裡了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um... probably. I'm so sorry.
dialogue.zh: 嗯……大概吧。真的很抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Don't worry, I'll print a fresh copy.
dialogue.phonetic: /doʊnt ˈwɜɹi aɪl prɪnt ə fɹɛʃ ˈkɑpi/
dialogue.zh: 別擔心，我列印一份新的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you! Are there extras at the desk?
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju ɑɹ ðɛɹ ˈɛkstɹəz æt ðə dɛsk/
dialogue.zh: 多謝！櫃台上還有多的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There are. Grab one before you go.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɑɹ ɡɹæb wʌn bɪˈfɔɹ ju goʊ/
dialogue.zh: 有的，離開前先去拿一張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more question, if that's okay.
dialogue.zh: 我可以再問一個問題嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, go ahead.
dialogue.zh: 當然，你說吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will the test cover tricky fractions?
dialogue.zh: 考試會考很難的那種嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only ones like what we did today.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli wʌnz laɪk wʌt wi dɪd təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 只考今天這種類型。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Phew, that makes me feel better.
dialogue.zh: 呼，這樣我覺得安心多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Emma, would you like the study group?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛmə wʊd ju laɪk ðə ˈstʌdi ɡɹup/
dialogue.zh: 艾瑪，你想參加課後練習小組嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A group? Who's in it?
dialogue.zh: 小組？裡面都有誰？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Four students, Fridays after class.
dialogue.zh: 四個學生，每週五下課後。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is Jake in that group?
dialogue.zh: 傑克也在那一組嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He is, and he's honestly pretty good.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi ɪz ænd hiz ˈɑnəstli ˈpɹɪti ɡʊd/
dialogue.zh: 他在。說實話，他程度挺厲害。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Perfect. Can I bring my cousin Lena?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜɹfɪkt kæn aɪ bɹɪŋ maɪ ˈkʌzən ˈlinə/
dialogue.zh: 太好了。我可以帶表姊蕾娜一起去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: New faces need the teacher's OK.
dialogue.zh: 新面孔要先經過老師同意。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll ask her today, then.
dialogue.zh: 那我今天先去問她。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great. Do you have any other questions?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹeɪt du ju hæv ˈɛni ˈʌðɚ ˈkwɛstʃənz/
dialogue.zh: 好，你還有別的問題嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Just one: is the group free, too?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst wʌn ɪz ðə ɡɹup fri tu/
dialogue.zh: 就一個：那個小組也是免費的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the school pays for everything.
dialogue.zh: 對，學校支付所有費用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, best news of my week.
dialogue.zh: 哇，這是我本週最好的消息。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell your mom, and keep practicing.
dialogue.zh: 回家告訴媽媽，然後繼續練習。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will. Should I finish the worksheet first?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl ʃʊd aɪ ˈfɪnɪʃ ðə ˈwɜkˌʃit fɜɹst/
dialogue.zh: 我會的。該先把學習單寫完嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, page twelve by Thursday, please.
dialogue.zh: 對，星期四以前寫完第十二頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Page twelve, got it. I'll try tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /peɪdʒ twɛlv ɡɑ ɪt aɪl traɪ təˈnaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 第十二頁，記得了，我今晚就寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: If you get stuck, write your questions down.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪf ju ɡɛt stʌk raɪt jɔɹ ˈkwɛstʃənz daʊn/
dialogue.zh: 卡住的話，就把問題寫下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good idea. Oh, my bus leaves at four!
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪˈdiə oʊ maɪ bʌs livz æt fɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 好主意。哎喲，我的四點巴士要開走了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then run! Lockers first, right?
dialogue.zh: 那快跑！先去置物櫃，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right! Can I take this new one home?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹaɪt kæn aɪ teɪk ðɪs nu wʌn hoʊm/
dialogue.zh: 對！這張新的我可以帶回家嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course. Grab a take-home folder, too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv ˈkɔɹs ɡɹæb ə teɪk hoʊm ˈfoʊldɚ tu/
dialogue.zh: 當然可以，也拿一個帶回家的資料夾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks! See you Thursday at three thirty.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks si ju ˈθɜɹzdeɪ æt θɹi ˈθɜɹti/
dialogue.zh: 多謝！我們星期四三點半見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring your notebook and a pencil, no phones.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɹɪŋ jɔɹ ˈnʌtˌbʊk ænd ə ˈpɛnsəl noʊ foʊnz/
dialogue.zh: 記得帶筆記本和一支鉛筆，不能帶手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it. No phones, just notes.
dialogue.zh: 知道了！不帶手機，只帶筆記。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly. And Emma, nice work today.
dialogue.zh: 就是這樣。艾瑪，你今天的表現很棒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks to you, fractions aren't scary.
dialogue.zh: 多虧你，分數一點都不可怕了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You did the hard part: staying late.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju dɪd ðə ˈhɑɹd pɑɹt steɪɪŋ leɪt/
dialogue.zh: 肯留到現在，本身就是最難的部分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I'm off. Bye, Ms. Park!
dialogue.zh: 好，我走啦。帕克老師再見！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bye, Emma. See you Thursday!
dialogue.zh: 再見艾瑪，週四見！
